privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: We keep as little about you as possible, explain exactly what and why, and let you take it with you or delete it at any time.

short.title: The short version
short.p1: Browsing and watching needs no account. An account is only needed to rate and react.
short.p2: For an account we keep your email, display name, a scrambled (hashed) password and when you accepted this notice.
short.p3: No analytics, no ads, no trackers, no IP addresses. One essential cookie keeps you logged in.
short.p4: Your watch progress never leaves your browser.
short.p5: Download your data or delete your account yourself, any time, from “My account”.

keep.title: What we keep, why and for how long
keep.intro: This is everything we store on our server that relates to you:

users.name: Your account
users.what: Email, display name, password hash (scrypt), date you accepted the privacy notice
users.why: To log you in, show your name in your account menu and prove your consent
users.until: You delete your account. Accounts never verified are deleted automatically after 7 days.

sessions.name: Login sessions
sessions.what: A SHA-256 fingerprint of your session token, your user id, expiry date
sessions.until: Expiry (30 days) — removed automatically; or when you log out / sign out everywhere

tokens.name: Email links
tokens.what: A SHA-256 fingerprint of the link's token, your user id, expiry date
tokens.why: To verify your email address or reset your password
tokens.until: Used or expired (24 hours to verify, 1 hour to reset) — removed automatically

ratings.name: Ratings
ratings.what: Your user id, the video, your score (1–5) and optional reaction
ratings.until: You remove the rating or delete your account

activity.name: Rating activity (not personal data)
activity.what: Anonymous daily totals per video (number of ratings, sum of scores) — no user id

privacy.never: We do not store IP addresses, browser user agents, analytics, advertising IDs or any third-party trackers.
